zh: 已经通过的科目缺口为0，自然计入；其余每科的代价是缺口needed−answered，而每通过一科的收益都是1。
收益相同而代价不同时，应当优先满足代价最小的科目；交换论证说明最优方案总能换成“缺口最小的若干科”。
计算每科的非负缺口max(0, needed[i]−answered[i])，升序排序后依次从预算q中扣除，付得起就计数，第一次付不起就停止，输出计数。q最大为10^14，使用64位整数。
en: Subjects already passed have a shortfall of 0 and count automatically; every other subject costs its shortfall needed−answered, while each passed subject is worth exactly 1.
With equal value and different costs, the cheapest subjects should be satisfied first; an exchange argument shows an optimal plan can always be turned into the subjects with the smallest shortfalls.

Compute each subject's non-negative shortfall max(0, needed[i]−answered[i]), sort ascending, and subtract them from the budget q in order, counting each one you can afford and stopping at the first you cannot; print the count. q can be up to 10^14, so use 64-bit integers.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Compute the non-negative shortfall of each subject, sort them in ascending order, and spend the budget on the smallest shortfalls first.

## Proof of correctness

Every passed subject contributes exactly 1. If a plan picks a larger shortfall but leaves out a smaller one, swapping them keeps the number of subjects and does not increase the questions used; repeated swaps give a prefix of the smallest shortfalls. The longest prefix the budget can cover, taken greedily, is optimal.

## Complexity

Time O(n log n), space O(n).
